jp: ご近所で評判の犬好き少女。愛犬のポピーを溺愛しているが、当の本犬にはやや鬱陶しがられている様子で、時々目を離した隙に脱走されてしまうことも。
jp_grezzo: "ご近所で評判の犬好き少女。愛犬のポピーを溺愛しているが、当の本犬にはやや鬱陶しがられている様子で、時々目を離した隙に脱走されてしまうことも。"
en: A dog-loving girl with a reputation in the neighbourhood. She loves her dog Poppy very much, but the dog seems a little depressed and sometimes escapes when she is out of sight.
en_grezzo: "A dog-loving girl with a reputation in the neighbourhood. She loves her dog Poppy very much, but the dog seems a little depressed and sometimes escapes when she is out of sight."
it: Una bambina che ama i cani, e nel vicinato lo sanno tutti. Stravede per Poppy, il suo cane, ma il diretto interessato pare la trovi un po' soffocante, e ogni tanto, appena lei distoglie lo sguardo, scappa via.

jp: 猫嫌いな青年。イルヴァでは猫は非常に人気の高い生き物であるため、肩身が狭い。元はパルミア暮らしだったがミーアとの近所トラブルの末にヨウィンに引っ越した。
jp_grezzo: "猫嫌いな青年。イルヴァでは猫は非常に人気の高い生き物であるため、肩身が狭い。元はパルミア暮らしだったがミーアとの近所トラブルの末にヨウィンに引っ越した。"
en: A young man who hates cats. Cats are very popular creatures in Irva, so he has a narrow shoulder to lean on. He used to live in Palmia but moved to Yowyn after neighbourhood problems with Mia.
en_grezzo: "A young man who hates cats. Cats are very popular creatures in Irva, so he has a narrow shoulder to lean on. He used to live in Palmia but moved to Yowyn after neighbourhood problems with Mia."
it: Un giovane che non sopporta i gatti. In Irva i gatti sono creature amatissime, e per questo lui se ne sta con la coda fra le gambe. Prima viveva a Palmia, ma dopo i guai di vicinato con Mia si è trasferito a Yowyn.

jp: 大人になりきれてない女性全般を指す。イルヴァではペットとしても一般的で、奴隷として買うこともできるし、脱走して野生化した個体を捕まえることもできる。
jp_grezzo: "大人になりきれてない女性全般を指す。イルヴァではペットとしても一般的で、奴隷として買うこともできるし、脱走して野生化した個体を捕まえることもできる。"
en: Usually the term 'little girl' refers to all women who have not fully grown up. They are also common as pets in Irva, and can be bought as slaves. Escaped individuals can be captured in the wild.
en_grezzo: "Usually the term 'little girl' refers to all women who have not fully grown up. They are also common as pets in Irva, and can be bought as slaves. Escaped individuals can be captured in the wild."
it: Il nome indica in generale le donne che non sono ancora diventate adulte. In Irva sono comuni anche come animali da compagnia, si possono comprare come schiave, e chi scappa e torna allo stato brado lo si può catturare.

jp: 雑食性の小動物。高い繁殖力と何でも食べてしまうその性質によって、大繁殖を起こし農作物を喰いつくす事もある。身体が割と大きく、猫に挑むこともある。
jp_grezzo: "雑食性の小動物。高い繁殖力と何でも食べてしまうその性質によって、大繁殖を起こし農作物を喰いつくす事もある。身体が割と大きく、猫に挑むこともある。"
en: Small omnivorous animals. Due to their high fertility and their propensity to eat anything, they can breed in large numbers and devour crops.They are rather large and can challenge cats.
en_grezzo: "Small omnivorous animals. Due to their high fertility and their propensity to eat anything, they can breed in large numbers and devour crops.They are rather large and can challenge cats."
it: Un animaletto onnivoro. Con la sua grande capacità di riprodursi e con il vizio di mangiare qualunque cosa, ogni tanto si moltiplica a dismisura e divora i raccolti. Ha un corpo piuttosto grande, e capita che sfidi anche un gatto.

jp: 貝殻などを仮の住まいとする甲殻類。見た目は蟹のようだが実際は海老の仲間。何処から拾ってきたのか、とても美しい貝を背負っているものも居る。
jp_grezzo: "貝殻などを仮の住まいとする甲殻類。見た目は蟹のようだが実際は海老の仲間。何処から拾ってきたのか、とても美しい貝を背負っているものも居る。"
en: A crustacean that makes shells and other objects its temporary home. They look like crabs but are actually prawns. Some of them carry very beautiful shells on their backs, which they may have picked up from somewhere.
en_grezzo: "A crustacean that makes shells and other objects its temporary home. They look like crabs but are actually prawns. Some of them carry very beautiful shells on their backs, which they may have picked up from somewhere."
it: Un crostaceo che si fa una casa provvisoria di una conchiglia o di quel che trova. All'aspetto sembra un granchio, ma in realtà è parente del gambero. Qualcuno se ne porta in spalla una bellissima, chissà dove raccolta.

jp: ジャグリングを披露しようとする流浪のピエロ。街でやらないのは市民のダメ出しを恐れているためらしい。迫力を重視するあまり、客に向けて様々なものを投げつけてくる。
jp_grezzo: "ジャグリングを披露しようとする流浪のピエロ。街でやらないのは市民のダメ出しを恐れているためらしい。迫力を重視するあまり、客に向けて様々なものを投げつけてくる。"
en: A wandering clown tries to perform juggling. The reason he doesn't do it in the city is apparently because he fears that the citizens will ruin it. He is so focused on power that he throws all sorts of things at the audience.
en_grezzo: "A wandering clown tries to perform juggling. The reason he doesn't do it in the city is apparently because he fears that the citizens will ruin it. He is so focused on power that he throws all sorts of things at the audience."
it: Un pagliaccio errante che vuole esibirsi con la giocoleria. Non lo fa in città, pare, per paura delle critiche dei cittadini. E siccome tiene troppo all'effetto, finisce per tirare addosso al pubblico ogni sorta di cosa.

jp: 女王でありながら、動きづらいという理由で高貴な服装を嫌う。家臣の猫たちも勝手気ままに生活しており、王家という感じがしない。何か嫌な思い出でもあるのか、尻尾に触ろうとすると慌てて逃げていく。
jp_grezzo: "女王でありながら、動きづらいという理由で高貴な服装を嫌う。家臣の猫たちも勝手気ままに生活しており、王家という感じがしない。何か嫌な思い出でもあるのか、尻尾に触ろうとすると慌てて逃げていく。"
en: Although she is a queen, she dislikes wearing noble clothes because they make it difficult to move around. The cats in her household also live a carefree life and do not feel like royalty. Perhaps because they have bad memories, they run away in a hurry when you try to touch their tails.
en_grezzo: "Although she is a queen, she dislikes wearing noble clothes because they make it difficult to move around. The cats in her household also live a carefree life and do not feel like royalty. Perhaps because they have bad memories, they run away in a hurry when you try to touch their tails."
it: È una regina, ma i vestiti nobili non li sopporta perché le impediscono di muoversi. Anche i gatti del suo seguito vivono come gli pare, e di casa reale non hanno proprio l'aria. Sarà per qualche brutto ricordo, ma appena provi a toccarle la coda scappa via di corsa.

jp: あなたと血の繋がっていない妹。妹は妹であるが故に妹なのであり、それ以上でもそれ以下でもない。よってこの子は間違いなくあなたの妹なのだ。
jp_grezzo: "あなたと血の繋がっていない妹。妹は妹であるが故に妹なのであり、それ以上でもそれ以下でもない。よってこの子は間違いなくあなたの妹なのだ。"
en: A younger sister who is not blood-related to you. A younger sister is a younger sister because she is a younger sister, nothing more, nothing less. Therefore, she is definitely your younger sister.
en_grezzo: "A younger sister who is not blood-related to you. A younger sister is a younger sister because she is a younger sister, nothing more, nothing less. Therefore, she is definitely your younger sister."
it: La tua sorella minore, che non ha il tuo sangue. Una sorella minore è una sorella minore perché è una sorella minore, né più né meno. E quindi questa qui è senza ombra di dubbio la tua sorella minore.

jp: 妹の館で愛情弁当を売っている、あなたと血の繋がっていない妹。この世の全てのお兄ちゃん・お姉ちゃんの妹とでもいうべき存在である。館、本人ともに、いつから存在しているのか不明。
jp_grezzo: "妹の館で愛情弁当を売っている、あなたと血の繋がっていない妹。この世の全てのお兄ちゃん・お姉ちゃんの妹とでもいうべき存在である。館、本人ともに、いつから存在しているのか不明。"
en: Your younger sister, who is not blood-related to you, sells affectionate lunches in her sister's pavilion. She is the younger sister of all the older brothers and sisters in this world. It is unclear how long both the pavilion and the person in question have existed.
en_grezzo: "Your younger sister, who is not blood-related to you, sells affectionate lunches in her sister's pavilion. She is the younger sister of all the older brothers and sisters in this world. It is unclear how long both the pavilion and the person in question have existed."
it: La tua sorella minore, che non ha il tuo sangue, e che al padiglione delle sorelle vende pranzi al sacco pieni d'affetto. È, si potrebbe dire, la sorella minore di tutti i fratelli e le sorelle maggiori di questo mondo. Da quando esistano lei e il padiglione, non si sa.

jp: 気まぐれな猫科の血の繋がらない義理の妹。好奇心が非常に旺盛だが、それ故に怪我をすることも多い。ブレザーを脱ぐときの静電気が嫌い。
jp_grezzo: "気まぐれな猫科の血の繋がらない義理の妹。好奇心が非常に旺盛だが、それ故に怪我をすることも多い。ブレザーを脱ぐときの静電気が嫌い。"
en: A non-blood related younger sister-in-law of a capricious cat family. Very curious, but therefore often injured. Dislikes static electricity when she takes off her blazer.
en_grezzo: "A non-blood related younger sister-in-law of a capricious cat family. Very curious, but therefore often injured. Dislikes static electricity when she takes off her blazer."
it: Una sorella acquisita, di stirpe felina e capricciosa, che non ha il tuo sangue. È curiosissima, e proprio per questo si fa spesso male. Non sopporta la scossa di statica quando si toglie il blazer.

jp: 世間知らずのお嬢様。由緒正しい家柄に育ったので、たとえ戦闘があったとしてもエレガントな仕草を忘れないよう心がけている。怪しい薬の調合が趣味。
jp_grezzo: "世間知らずのお嬢様。由緒正しい家柄に育ったので、たとえ戦闘があったとしてもエレガントな仕草を忘れないよう心がけている。怪しい薬の調合が趣味。"
en: A naive young lady. Having grown up in a venerable family, she tries to remember elegant gestures even if there is fighting. She enjoys concocting weird medicines.
en_grezzo: "A naive young lady. Having grown up in a venerable family, she tries to remember elegant gestures even if there is fighting. She enjoys concocting weird medicines."
it: Una signorina che non sa niente del mondo. È cresciuta in una famiglia di antico lignaggio, e perciò bada a non dimenticare i gesti eleganti nemmeno se si combatte. Il suo passatempo è mescolare medicine sospette.

jp: パルミア南にある混沌の城を延々と守り続けている、古代機械文明の遺産。長年起動し続けていたため各部が経年劣化しているが、それでも驚異的な戦闘力を誇る。
jp_grezzo: "パルミア南にある混沌の城を延々と守り続けている、古代機械文明の遺産。長年起動し続けていたため各部が経年劣化しているが、それでも驚異的な戦闘力を誇る。"
en: A legacy of an ancient mechanical civilisation that has endlessly defended the Castle of Chaos south of Palmia. Although every part of the machine has deteriorated over the years as it has been running for many years, it still boasts an astonishing fighting power.
en_grezzo: "A legacy of an ancient mechanical civilisation that has endlessly defended the Castle of Chaos south of Palmia. Although every part of the machine has deteriorated over the years as it has been running for many years, it still boasts an astonishing fighting power."
it: Un lascito dell'antica civiltà meccanica, che senza sosta continua a difendere il castello del caos a sud di Palmia. Sta in funzione da tanti anni e ogni sua parte è logorata dal tempo, eppure vanta ancora una potenza di combattimento prodigiosa.

jp: 古き邪神に仕える。彼の神の名の下、不浄なる外法でもって人の枠から逸脱した忌むべき存在。今は混沌の城に引きこもり、延々と魔法の研究をしている。
jp_grezzo: "古き邪神に仕える。彼の神の名の下、不浄なる外法でもって人の枠から逸脱した忌むべき存在。今は混沌の城に引きこもり、延々と魔法の研究をしている。"
en: He serves an old evil god. Under the name of his god, he is an abomination who has deviated from the boundaries of humanity with his impure external laws. He is now shut up in the Castle of Chaos, endlessly researching magic.
en_grezzo: "He serves an old evil god. Under the name of his god, he is an abomination who has deviated from the boundaries of humanity with his impure external laws. He is now shut up in the Castle of Chaos, endlessly researching magic."
it: Serve un antico dio malvagio. Nel nome di quel dio, con arti immonde e proibite, è uscito dal recinto dell'uomo ed è diventato una presenza da aborrire. Adesso se ne sta chiuso nel castello del caos, a studiare magia senza fine.

jp: 貴族が自尊心を満足させるため各々のペットを私闘させる様をヒントにして、ペット用のアリーナを設けた。獣人のような姿だが、実はマスコットキャラの着ぐるみである。
jp_grezzo: "貴族が自尊心を満足させるため各々のペットを私闘させる様をヒントにして、ペット用のアリーナを設けた。獣人のような姿だが、実はマスコットキャラの着ぐるみである。"
en: The arena was set up for pets, inspired by the way aristocrats let their pets fight private battles to satisfy their self-esteem. Although they look like beastmen, they are actually stuffed mascot characters.
en_grezzo: "The arena was set up for pets, inspired by the way aristocrats let their pets fight private battles to satisfy their self-esteem. Although they look like beastmen, they are actually stuffed mascot characters."
it: Ha aperto un'arena per gli animali da compagnia, prendendo spunto dai nobili che, per soddisfare il proprio orgoglio, fanno duellare i rispettivi animali. Ha l'aspetto di un uomo bestia, ma in verità è un costume da mascotte.

jp: 伝説級の腕を持つ寡黙な鍛冶師。作る物は形こそ無骨で均一的だが、どれも実用性が高い装備品やアイテムである。ミラルとは幼少の頃からの腐れ縁。
jp_grezzo: "伝説級の腕を持つ寡黙な鍛冶師。作る物は形こそ無骨で均一的だが、どれも実用性が高い装備品やアイテムである。ミラルとは幼少の頃からの腐れ縁。"
en: A taciturn blacksmith with legendary skills. The objects he makes are rugged and uniform in form, but they are all highly practical equipment and items. He and Miral have been friends since childhood.
en_grezzo: "A taciturn blacksmith with legendary skills. The objects he makes are rugged and uniform in form, but they are all highly practical equipment and items. He and Miral have been friends since childhood."
it: Un fabbro taciturno, con un'abilità da leggenda. Quel che fabbrica ha forme rozze e tutte uguali, ma sono equipaggiamenti e oggetti di grande utilità. Con Miral si trascina dietro un'amicizia scomoda fin da bambini.

jp: 伝説級の腕を持つ陽気な鍛冶師。気まぐれで自分の気に入った仕事しかしないのだが、その遊び心あふれる彼の作品にはファンも多い。猫大好き。
jp_grezzo: "伝説級の腕を持つ陽気な鍛冶師。気まぐれで自分の気に入った仕事しかしないのだが、その遊び心あふれる彼の作品にはファンも多い。猫大好き。"
en: A cheerful blacksmith with legendary skills. He is capricious and only does work he likes, but his playful creations have many fans. Loves cats.
en_grezzo: "A cheerful blacksmith with legendary skills. He is capricious and only does work he likes, but his playful creations have many fans. Loves cats."
it: Un fabbro allegro, con un'abilità da leggenda. È lunatico e lavora solo a quel che gli piace, ma i suoi pezzi, pieni di estro, hanno molti ammiratori. Va matto per i gatti.

jp: 二本の尻尾が特徴的な猫。高い知能をもち、人間以外の生物で初めて、神を祀っているのが確認された生物でもある。食べてもエビみたいな味はしない。
jp_grezzo: "二本の尻尾が特徴的な猫。高い知能をもち、人間以外の生物で初めて、神を祀っているのが確認された生物でもある。食べてもエビみたいな味はしない。"
en: A cat with two tails. It is highly intelligent and was the first non-human creature confirmed to worship a deity. They do not taste like prawns when eaten.
en_grezzo: "A cat with two tails. It is highly intelligent and was the first non-human creature confirmed to worship a deity. They do not taste like prawns when eaten."
it: Un gatto che si riconosce per le due code. Ha un'intelligenza alta, ed è il primo essere vivente non umano di cui si sia accertato che venera una divinità. A mangiarlo, comunque, non sa di gambero.

jp: 美しい毛並みを持つ狼。実は見た目に反して猟犬よりも温厚な気質で、攻撃もそこまで凶暴ではない。銀というより灰色のような気もする。
jp_grezzo: "美しい毛並みを持つ狼。実は見た目に反して猟犬よりも温厚な気質で、攻撃もそこまで凶暴ではない。銀というより灰色のような気もする。"
en: Wolves with beautiful fur. In fact, despite its appearance, it has a milder temperament than a hound and its attacks are not as ferocious. It seems more grey than silver.
en_grezzo: "Wolves with beautiful fur. In fact, despite its appearance, it has a milder temperament than a hound and its attacks are not as ferocious. It seems more grey than silver."
it: Un lupo dal pelo bellissimo. A dispetto dell'aspetto ha in realtà un temperamento più mite di quello di un segugio, e nemmeno i suoi attacchi sono così feroci. Più che argento, viene da dire grigio.

jp: 傷ついた者を癒すことに情熱を燃やす白衣の天使。あまりにやる気がありすぎるために負傷者が現れるのを待つことができず、その結果自ら戦いの場へ身を投じた。
jp_grezzo: "傷ついた者を癒すことに情熱を燃やす白衣の天使。あまりにやる気がありすぎるために負傷者が現れるのを待つことができず、その結果自ら戦いの場へ身を投じた。"
en: An angel in white with a passion for healing the wounded. She was too motivated to wait for the wounded to show up, and as a result she threw herself into the battlefield.
en_grezzo: "An angel in white with a passion for healing the wounded. She was too motivated to wait for the wounded to show up, and as a result she threw herself into the battlefield."
it: Un angelo in camice bianco, che arde di passione per guarire chi è ferito. Aveva talmente voglia di darsi da fare che non riusciva ad aspettare l'arrivo dei feriti, e alla fine si è buttata lei stessa nel campo di battaglia.

jp: 階級を持たないものの、様々な方法で財産と権力を手にした者。一代目の出世譚は、非常に興味深く面白い読み物として出回ったり、語り継がれる事もある。
jp_grezzo: "階級を持たないものの、様々な方法で財産と権力を手にした者。一代目の出世譚は、非常に興味深く面白い読み物として出回ったり、語り継がれる事もある。"
en: A person who has no rank but has acquired wealth and power in a variety of ways. Tales of the rise of the first generation are sometimes circulated and retold as very interesting and entertaining reading.
en_grezzo: "A person who has no rank but has acquired wealth and power in a variety of ways. Tales of the rise of the first generation are sometimes circulated and retold as very interesting and entertaining reading."
it: Uno che, pur senza avere un titolo, con i mezzi più vari si è procurato ricchezza e potere. Il racconto della scalata del capostipite ogni tanto circola come lettura curiosa e divertente, e si tramanda.

jp: 社交デビューと同時にテロに遭う事も多いため、戦闘の心得も必須教育の一環である。自由に街で遊んでいる子供たちを窓から眺めては羨む毎日が続く。
jp_grezzo: "社交デビューと同時にテロに遭う事も多いため、戦闘の心得も必須教育の一環である。自由に街で遊んでいる子供たちを窓から眺めては羨む毎日が続く。"
en: As they are often terrorised at the same time as making their social debut, a knowledge of combat is part of their mandatory education. Every day he looks out of the window at the children playing freely in the streets and envies them.
en_grezzo: "As they are often terrorised at the same time as making their social debut, a knowledge of combat is part of their mandatory education. Every day he looks out of the window at the children playing freely in the streets and envies them."
it: Siccome capita spesso di finire in un attentato proprio il giorno del debutto in società, saper combattere fa parte dell'istruzione obbligatoria. E ogni giorno guarda dalla finestra i bambini che giocano liberi per la città, e li invidia.

jp: 強い好奇心に駆られ、各地を観て回る人々。興味を引く物に意識がすぐ行ってしまうので、スリの被害に遭うのは日常茶飯事となってしまっている。
jp_grezzo: "強い好奇心に駆られ、各地を観て回る人々。興味を引く物に意識がすぐ行ってしまうので、スリの被害に遭うのは日常茶飯事となってしまっている。"
en: Driven by a strong sense of curiosity, there are people who travel around to see different parts of the country. Because they are easily distracted by objects of interest, being the victim of pickpocketing has become an everyday occurrence.
en_grezzo: "Driven by a strong sense of curiosity, there are people who travel around to see different parts of the country. Because they are easily distracted by objects of interest, being the victim of pickpocketing has become an everyday occurrence."
it: Gente che, spinta da una curiosità forte, va in giro a vedere posti su posti. La testa gli va subito dietro a quello che li incuriosisce, e così finire derubati da un borsaiolo è diventato pane quotidiano.

jp: 大きなお祭りがあると聞きつけて、遠く離れた国からやって来た。何のお祭りかはあまり重視しておらず、屋台や雰囲気を楽しみに来ているようだ。
jp_grezzo: "大きなお祭りがあると聞きつけて、遠く離れた国からやって来た。何のお祭りかはあまり重視しておらず、屋台や雰囲気を楽しみに来ているようだ。"
en: They came from faraway countries after hearing about a big festival. They don't seem to attach much importance to what the festival is about, but come to enjoy the stalls and atmosphere.
en_grezzo: "They came from faraway countries after hearing about a big festival. They don't seem to attach much importance to what the festival is about, but come to enjoy the stalls and atmosphere."
it: È arrivato da un paese lontano, dopo aver sentito che c'era una gran festa. Di che festa sia gli importa poco: viene per godersi le bancarelle e l'aria che tira.

jp: 遺跡から発掘された機械兵士。両手に鋭い刃物を持ち無慈悲にあらゆる生物を切り刻むキラーマシーン。腕部を反転変形させることで人型の手が出現するため、他の武器を持つことも可能。
jp_grezzo: "遺跡から発掘された機械兵士。両手に鋭い刃物を持ち無慈悲にあらゆる生物を切り刻むキラーマシーン。腕部を反転変形させることで人型の手が出現するため、他の武器を持つことも可能。"
en: Mechanical soldiers excavated from ruins. A killer machine with sharp blades in both hands that mercilessly mutilate all living creatures.By inverting and transforming its arms, a humanoid hand appears, which can also hold other weapons.
en_grezzo: "Mechanical soldiers excavated from ruins. A killer machine with sharp blades in both hands that mercilessly mutilate all living creatures.By inverting and transforming its arms, a humanoid hand appears, which can also hold other weapons."
it: Un soldato meccanico dissotterrato dalle rovine. È una macchina che uccide, con una lama affilata in ciascuna mano, e fa a pezzi senza pietà qualunque essere vivente. Ribaltando e trasformando le braccia gli spunta una mano come quella umana, e così può impugnare anche altre armi.

jp: ブレイドを改修し能力を向上させたもの。違いは分かる人にしか分からない。なお、ブレイドシリーズの中にはテスト用に耐刃性の腰当を装備したものが僅かながら存在する。
jp_grezzo: "ブレイドを改修し能力を向上させたもの。違いは分かる人にしか分からない。なお、ブレイドシリーズの中にはテスト用に耐刃性の腰当を装備したものが僅かながら存在する。"
en: A refurbished version of the Blade with improved capabilities. Only those who know the difference can tell the difference.It should be noted that a small number of the Blade series are equipped with a blade-resistant waistplate for testing purposes.
en_grezzo: "A refurbished version of the Blade with improved capabilities. Only those who know the difference can tell the difference.It should be noted that a small number of the Blade series are equipped with a blade-resistant waistplate for testing purposes."
it: Una lama rimessa a punto e migliorata nelle capacità. La differenza la coglie soltanto chi se ne intende. Da notare che nella serie delle lame ne esistono alcune, poche, con un paraschiena resistente al taglio, montato per le prove.

jp: より効率よく、残忍に生物を殺戮する為に改良された機械兵士。その身は返り血で赤く染まりもはや元の色すら分からない。刃の部分は切れ味が鈍ると勝手に折れて次の新しい刃が生えてくる。
jp_grezzo: "より効率よく、残忍に生物を殺戮する為に改良された機械兵士。その身は返り血で赤く染まりもはや元の色すら分からない。刃の部分は切れ味が鈍ると勝手に折れて次の新しい刃が生えてくる。"
en: A mechanical soldier improved to more efficiently and brutally slaughter living creatures. Its body is stained red from the blood returning to it, and even its original colour is no longer recognisable.When the blade becomes dull, it breaks off by itself and a new blade grows back.
en_grezzo: "A mechanical soldier improved to more efficiently and brutally slaughter living creatures. Its body is stained red from the blood returning to it, and even its original colour is no longer recognisable.When the blade becomes dull, it breaks off by itself and a new blade grows back."
it: Un soldato meccanico migliorato per massacrare gli esseri viventi in modo più efficiente e più crudele. Il corpo è tinto di rosso dal sangue schizzato addosso, e ormai non si capisce nemmeno di che colore fosse. Quando la lama perde il filo si spezza da sola, e ne spunta una nuova.

jp: 伝説のモンスターマシン。ABSや対障害物用レーダー、オートナビなどのシステムに加え、12000回転で200馬力以上出すエンジンを備える。
jp_grezzo: "伝説のモンスターマシン。ABSや対障害物用レーダー、オートナビなどのシステムに加え、12000回転で200馬力以上出すエンジンを備える。"
en: Legendary monster machine, with systems such as ABS, anti-obstacle radar and auto-navigation, plus an engine producing over 200 hp at 12,000 rpm.
en_grezzo: "Legendary monster machine, with systems such as ABS, anti-obstacle radar and auto-navigation, plus an engine producing over 200 hp at 12,000 rpm. "
it: La leggendaria macchina mostruosa. Oltre a sistemi come l'ABS, il radar contro gli ostacoli e la navigazione automatica, monta un motore che a dodicimila giri dà più di duecento cavalli.

jp: 頑丈で燃費が良いだけでなく、高い生命力と速度を持つ機械の馬。世話の仕方が違うため、馬屋では扱っていない。
jp_grezzo: "頑丈で燃費が良いだけでなく、高い生命力と速度を持つ機械の馬。世話の仕方が違うため、馬屋では扱っていない。"
en: Mechanical horses that are not only robust and fuel-efficient, but also have high vitality and speed. They are not handled in horse stalls because of the different way they are cared for.
en_grezzo: "Mechanical horses that are not only robust and fuel-efficient, but also have high vitality and speed. They are not handled in horse stalls because of the different way they are cared for."
it: Un cavallo meccanico che non è soltanto robusto e parco di carburante, ma ha anche una grande forza vitale e una bella velocità. Va accudito in un altro modo, e perciò nelle stalle non lo trattano.

jp: 地雷をせっせと埋める姿が犬に似ていることから命名されたが、実物を見た冒険者は大抵その奇妙な姿に首を捻る。重力発生装置を内蔵。
jp_grezzo: "地雷をせっせと埋める姿が犬に似ていることから命名されたが、実物を見た冒険者は大抵その奇妙な姿に首を捻る。重力発生装置を内蔵。"
en: Named after the dog-like appearance of the mines that it impatiently buries, adventurers who see it in the flesh usually twist their heads at its strange appearance. Has a built-in gravity generator.
en_grezzo: "Named after the dog-like appearance of the mines that it impatiently buries, adventurers who see it in the flesh usually twist their heads at its strange appearance. Has a built-in gravity generator."
it: Il nome gli viene dal fatto che, mentre sotterra mine una dopo l'altra, somiglia a un cane; ma gli avventurieri che lo vedono dal vivo di solito storcono la testa davanti a quella forma strana. Dentro ha un generatore di gravità.

jp: 機械仕掛けの全自動処刑道具。攻撃を受けると胴体の扉を開き、内部に取り付けられた鋭い針で攻撃者を突き刺して反撃する。
jp_grezzo: "機械仕掛けの全自動処刑道具。攻撃を受けると胴体の扉を開き、内部に取り付けられた鋭い針で攻撃者を突き刺して反撃する。"
en: A mechanical, fully automatic execution tool. When attacked, it opens a door in its torso, and then counterattacks by piercing the attacker with a sharp needle attached to its interior.
en_grezzo: "A mechanical, fully automatic execution tool. When attacked, it opens a door in its torso, and then counterattacks by piercing the attacker with a sharp needle attached to its interior."
it: Uno strumento di esecuzione meccanico e tutto automatico. Quando lo attacchi apre lo sportello del busto e risponde infilzando chi lo ha colpito con gli aghi affilati montati all'interno.

jp: その肉体は狂気に染まっているため、一口食べるだけでも気が狂ってしまうだろう。相手の身体を変化させる特殊能力をもつ。
jp_grezzo: "その肉体は狂気に染まっているため、一口食べるだけでも気が狂ってしまうだろう。相手の身体を変化させる特殊能力をもつ。"
en: Its body is so tainted with madness that just one bite would drive it insane. It has the special ability to change the body of its opponents.
en_grezzo: "Its body is so tainted with madness that just one bite would drive it insane. It has the special ability to change the body of its opponents."
it: Il suo corpo è intriso di follia, e basterebbe un morso solo per uscire di senno. Ha il potere speciale di trasformare il corpo di chi ha davanti.

jp: 邪眼と呼ばれる濁った眼をもつ。妖精の帽子はこの魔物の眼差しによる肉体変化を防ぐために作られたとされる。
jp_grezzo: "邪眼と呼ばれる濁った眼をもつ。妖精の帽子はこの魔物の眼差しによる肉体変化を防ぐために作られたとされる。"
en: It has a cloudy eye called the evil eye. Fairy hats are said to have been made to prevent physical changes caused by this monster's eye.
en_grezzo: "It has a cloudy eye called the evil eye. Fairy hats are said to have been made to prevent physical changes caused by this monster's eye."
it: Ha un occhio torbido, che chiamano il malocchio. Si dice che il cappello delle fate sia stato inventato apposta per impedire i mutamenti del corpo provocati dallo sguardo di questo mostro.

jp: エネルギーを吐き出し切った放電雲が代替として大量のエーテルを取り込んだ。厄災の前兆として恐れられており、追いかけると良くない事が起きると伝えられている。
jp_grezzo: "エネルギーを吐き出し切った放電雲が代替として大量のエーテルを取り込んだ。厄災の前兆として恐れられており、追いかけると良くない事が起きると伝えられている。"
en: Discharge clouds that have exhausted their energy have taken in large amounts of ether as a replacement. It is feared as an omen of disaster and bad things are reported to happen if it is chased.
en_grezzo: "Discharge clouds that have exhausted their energy have taken in large amounts of ether as a replacement. It is feared as an omen of disaster and bad things are reported to happen if it is chased."
it: Una nube elettrica che, sputata via tutta l'energia, si è riempita in cambio di una gran quantità di etere. Lo si teme come presagio di sciagura, e si racconta che a inseguirlo succedano cose brutte.

jp: 体毛で出来た鋭い針を背中に多数持つ。かつて同じ名前のモグラが存在していたがこちらは既に絶滅しており、種族的にもまったくの別物。
jp_grezzo: "体毛で出来た鋭い針を背中に多数持つ。かつて同じ名前のモグラが存在していたがこちらは既に絶滅しており、種族的にもまったくの別物。"
en: It has numerous sharp needles on its back made of body hair. A mole of the same name once existed, but this one is already extinct and is a completely different species.
en_grezzo: "It has numerous sharp needles on its back made of body hair. A mole of the same name once existed, but this one is already extinct and is a completely different species."
it: Porta sulla schiena tanti aghi affilati, fatti di pelo. Un tempo esisteva una talpa con lo stesso nome, ma quella si è già estinta, ed erano comunque due specie del tutto diverse.

jp: 食性の影響で体内に大量のエーテルを蓄えたハリねずみ。背中の針は固いが脆いという性質を持ち、刺さると体内に破片が残ってしまう。
jp_grezzo: "食性の影響で体内に大量のエーテルを蓄えたハリねずみ。背中の針は固いが脆いという性質を持ち、刺さると体内に破片が残ってしまう。"
en: A hedgehog with a large amount of ether stored in its body due to its feeding habits. The needles on its back are hard but brittle, and if they puncture, they leave fragments in the body.
en_grezzo: "A hedgehog with a large amount of ether stored in its body due to its feeding habits. The needles on its back are hard but brittle, and if they puncture, they leave fragments in the body."
it: Un riccio che, per via di quello che mangia, ha accumulato in corpo una gran quantità di etere. Gli aghi della schiena sono duri ma fragili, e quando ti si conficcano dentro ci lasciano delle schegge.

jp: 頻繁に卵を産んでくれるため、家畜として人気のある鳥。脱走した個体がよく野生化している。気性は荒いが、ちょっかいを出してきた勇者を返り討ちにできるほどではない。
jp_grezzo: "頻繁に卵を産んでくれるため、家畜として人気のある鳥。脱走した個体がよく野生化している。気性は荒いが、ちょっかいを出してきた勇者を返り討ちにできるほどではない。"
en: A popular domesticated bird because of its frequent egg-laying. Escaped individuals are often found in the wild. They have a rough temperament, but not so rough that they can repel a adventurer who messes with them.
en_grezzo: "A popular domesticated bird because of its frequent egg-laying. Escaped individuals are often found in the wild. They have a rough temperament, but not so rough that they can repel a adventurer who messes with them."
it: Un uccello molto apprezzato come animale da cortile, perché fa uova di frequente. Chi scappa spesso torna allo stato brado. Ha un caratteraccio, ma non al punto da respingere un eroe che vada a stuzzicarlo.

jp: 野菜の南瓜が変異して生まれた。豊富に含まれる栄養は頭によく、明晰になることから、親が子供に食べさせる風習がある。
jp_grezzo: "野菜の南瓜が変異して生まれた。豊富に含まれる栄養は頭によく、明晰になることから、親が子供に食べさせる風習がある。"
en: It is a mutated form of the vegetable pumpkin. It is customary for parents to feed it to their children as the rich nutritional content is good for the brain and makes them mentally lucid.
en_grezzo: "It is a mutated form of the vegetable pumpkin. It is customary for parents to feed it to their children as the rich nutritional content is good for the brain and makes them mentally lucid."
it: È nata dalla mutazione della zucca da orto. Le sostanze nutrienti che contiene in abbondanza fanno bene alla testa e schiariscono le idee, e per questo c'è l'usanza di darla da mangiare ai figli.

jp: 野菜の南瓜が変異して生まれた。透明な姿を利用して遠くからポーションを投げてくるが、投擲技術はまだまだ未熟。つるの部分が投擲に適した形状になっていないためらしい。
jp_grezzo: "野菜の南瓜が変異して生まれた。透明な姿を利用して遠くからポーションを投げてくるが、投擲技術はまだまだ未熟。つるの部分が投擲に適した形状になっていないためらしい。"
en: It is a mutated form of the vegetable pumpkin. It uses its transparent appearance to throw potions from a distance, but its throwing technique is still in its infancy. This is apparently because the vines are not shaped in a way that is suitable for throwing.
en_grezzo: "It is a mutated form of the vegetable pumpkin. It uses its transparent appearance to throw potions from a distance, but its throwing technique is still in its infancy. This is apparently because the vines are not shaped in a way that is suitable for throwing."
it: È nata dalla mutazione della zucca da orto. Approfitta del proprio aspetto trasparente per tirare pozioni da lontano, ma nel lancio è ancora acerba. Pare che sia perché il tralcio non ha la forma adatta a tirare.

jp: 化け物サイズに育った南瓜に自我が宿った。初めて遭遇したヨウィンの農夫によってそのまんまの名前をつけられた。肉食に目覚めて動物を食べまくった結果、実から野菜っぽい味が消えた。
jp_grezzo: "化け物サイズに育った南瓜に自我が宿った。初めて遭遇したヨウィンの農夫によってそのまんまの名前をつけられた。肉食に目覚めて動物を食べまくった結果、実から野菜っぽい味が消えた。"
en: A pumpkin that grew to the size of a monster developed an ego. It was named exactly as it was by a Yowyn farmer who encountered it for the first time. As a result of his carnivorous awakening and eating animals all over the place, the fruit lost its vegetable-like taste.
en_grezzo: "A pumpkin that grew to the size of a monster developed an ego. It was named exactly as it was by a Yowyn farmer who encountered it for the first time. As a result of his carnivorous awakening and eating animals all over the place, the fruit lost its vegetable-like taste."
it: Una zucca cresciuta fino a una taglia da mostro, in cui si è destata una coscienza. Il nome gliel'ha dato tale e quale il contadino di Yowyn che per primo la incontrò. Poi si è svegliata carnivora, e a furia di mangiare animali dalla sua polpa il sapore di verdura è sparito.
